title: Furo's founders left Silicon Valley — and it's paying off | TechCrunch
summary: And just a year after its founding, Furo has locked in enterprise clients such as German rail company Deutsche Bahn. “We’re currently moving faster in Europe than if we’d have stayed in the U.S.,” Furo co-founder Lena Sophia Voß said.
